newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-FALLON FINED FOR MISLEADING STEWARDS.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-FALLON FINED FOR MISLEADING STEWARDS.

text.p: Controversial Irish jockey Kieren Fallon was fined 1,500 pounds ($2,500) on Wednesday after being found guilty of "misleading the stewards of the Jockey Club".

Fallon was fined by the disciplinary committee of the Jockey Club, horse racing's ruling body in Britain, because of discrepancies in his explanation for missing an original hearing in July for medical book irregularities when he said he had got lost in traffic in London.
At a rearranged inquiry later in July he was banned for five days when the Jockey Club deemed he had made insufficient effort to attend.
Fallon, 31, who reached his first century of winners in a season this year, has a lengthy disciplinary record and was banned for a day earlier this year for kicking and punching a jockey in India.
